papers.title: Deep learning-driven integrated pipeline for de novo design and synthesis of antimicrobial peptides
deep-AMPpred: A Deep Learning Method for Identifying Antimicrobial Peptides and Their Functional Activities.
Rapid Response Antimicrobial Peptide Design Strategy Driven by Meta-Learning for Emerging Drug-Resistant Pathogens.
Design and evaluation of octopromycin-derived peptides as multifunctional antimicrobial agents against multidrug-resistant pathogens.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Soft-prompt tuned ProtGPT2 (a transformer-based protein language model). Only prompt parameters are updated; base model remains frozen.
models.input_features: Amino acid sequences (input embeddings with soft prompt)
models.candidate_reason: Generative model for AMPs; can be used in benchmarking pipelines for de novo AMP design.
blocking_issues: No code or trained model weights provided

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Ensemble: ESM-2 (esm2_t33_650M_UR50D) embeddings fed into MLP, CNN, and attention-based Bi-LSTM experts; dynamic voting network with self-confidence hinge loss.
models.input_features: ESM-2 residue-level embeddings from amino acid sequences
models.candidate_reason: AMP prediction model achieving 88.89% sensitivity, 87.63% specificity, AUC 94.66%, MCC 76.53% on validation set; suitable for benchmarking AMP classifiers.
blocking_issues: No code or trained model weights provided

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Dual-stream: ESM-2 embeddings + knowledge-enhanced transformer encoder; CARE (Conservative Adaptive Residual Encoder) for local motifs; ProBiMamba (bidirectional Mamba-inspired) for long-range dependencies; cross-modal attention fusion; focal loss for class imbalance.
models.input_features: Amino acid sequences (plus 56-dimensional handcrafted physicochemical features, sliding-window statistics, positional indices, global descriptors)
models.dataset_source_or_link: Benchmark dataset: integrated from dbAMP, DBAASP, APD3, DRAMP, etc. (no single download link); 25,507 AMPs and 72,606 non-AMPs. Independent validation set: 24,582 AMPs, 36,653 non-AMPs.
models.candidate_reason: Comprehensive AMP predictor covering 14 functional activities; code available for benchmarking; strong performance on independent test set.

datasets.dataset_source: Integrated from nine curated AMP databases (dbAMP, DBAASP, APD3, DRAMP, etc.) published 2021-2024.
datasets.deduplication_method: CD-HIT used to remove duplicates and control redundancy (details in paper)
datasets.evidence: The benchmark dataset was developed by refining the original iAMPCN resource ... integrated functional annotations from nine curated AMP-related databases ... final benchmark dataset comprised 25,507 AMPs and 72,606 non-AMPs.

datasets.dataset_source: Positive samples from same curated databases; negative samples from UniProt (excluding AMP-related keywords).
datasets.deduplication_method: CD-HIT at 100% identity against benchmark, then 40% internal redundancy.
datasets.evidence: The final independent validation dataset comprised 24,582 AMPs and 36,653 non-AMPs (Table 1).

important_evidence: AMP-GPT: soft-prompt tuned ProtGPT2, only prompt parameters updated, base model frozen.
MCL-AMP: ensemble of MLP, CNN, attention Bi-LSTM with dynamic voting; validation metrics: sensitivity 88.89%, specificity 87.63%, AUC 94.66%, MCC 76.53%.

MAPLE: dual-stream model combining ESM-2 embeddings and handcrafted features; CARE and ProBiMamba modules; benchmark dataset 25,507 AMPs / 72,606 non-AMPs; independent test 24,582 AMPs / 36,653 non-AMPs.
uncertainties: PMCID 13267055 is shared by two papers with different DOIs (10.1021/acs.jmedchem.5c00188 and 10.1038/s44386-026-00045-6). The evidence for AMP-GPT and MCL-AMP comes from the latter, but metadata attribution may be inconsistent.
The paper titled 'deep-AMPpred' (PMID:39792442) describes MAPLE; 'deep-AMPpred' may be an alias for MAPLE or a separate model name used in the publication.
No code or web server was found for AMP-GPT or MCL-AMP.
Training data for AMP-GPT and MCL-AMP are not fully specified; only 'validated antimicrobial sequence datasets' mentioned.
